description: Capability for the main window (spec M0.4: dialog plugin only; window controls via core). Window-management surface: drag + the Windows caption verbs, plus set-size/set-fullscreen/center — the CI tour's responsive steps drive the same core verbs any future window-layout feature would (the session-17 mac audit proved setSize/setFullscreen silently no-op without them: every capture stayed 1440x860 through the window-min/window-full steps).
